The wood

a point crawl
Winter Burrow · GM

Moving

  • Walk a path: mark its hours. The number in each place is its hours from home by the shortest way.
  • Every path across the Brook is a DEX save, or wet. Tobben's stones: no save.
  • Deep snow is counted. Felted boots take 1 off each Long Field path.
  • Roll an encounter where she stops, not where she passes through.
  • A snowstorm adds an hour to the trip out and an hour to the trip home.
  • A sled can't go into the Larch hollow, the Pit's lower cut or the Shed rafters.
